说明触发条件、原有行为和修改后的行为，保持范围集中。 -->

## Related issue / 关联问题

<!-- Link an issue if relevant. For substantial changes, link the discussion of scope.
如有关联 issue，请附链接；较大改动请链接此前的范围讨论。 -->

<!-- List exact commands and results, plus skipped or untested paths.

列出实际运行的命令、结果、跳过及尚未验证的部分。
将自动测试与实际浏览器预览、Blender 渲染检查分别说明。 -->

- Automated checks / 自动检查：
- Manual checks and evidence / 手动检查与证据：
- Not tested / 尚未验证：

## Screenshots or examples / 截图或示例

<!-- For UI changes, include relevant before/after desktop and narrow-width views, with affected languages.
For documentation-only changes, note link/command review; a render is unnecessary.
界面改动请附相关桌面与窄屏前后截图，并说明检查的语言。
仅修改文档时说明链接和命令检查，无需渲染。 -->

## Ready for review / 提交前确认

- [ ] The change preserves the applicable [workflow boundaries](https://github.com/Jack-ItsMe/Blender2Easy/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#work-on-the-code). / 改动保留适用的[工作流边界](https://github.com/Jack-ItsMe/Blender2Easy/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.zh-CN.md#修改代码)。
- [ ] Affected documentation, tests and third-party provenance are updated, or the description explains why no update is needed. / 已更新受影响的文档、测试与第三方 provenance，或说明不需要更新的原因。
- [ ] Examples and logs contain no credentials, private paths or assets I cannot redistribute. / 示例与日志不含凭据、私人路径或无权再分发的资产。
